speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: This will ensure skills diversity and more career mobility for all public officers.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Public Service will also need to build capabilities in science, technology and engineering.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Public Service is reorganising itself to leverage Science and Technology (S&T) advancements to overcome manpower, fiscal, land and carbon constraints.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: For example, the Land Transport Authority supports the public sector’s shift to clean energy vehicles; the Urban Redevelopment Authority supports urban operations and service delivery through urban modelling and simulation platforms.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Strong leadership is critical to the Public Service’s effectiveness in an increasingly complex environment.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We will continue to invest in developing our pipeline of leaders, ensuring that there is diversity of skills and experiences.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: We are diversifying our selection and sourcing process for scholarship holders and direct recruits, beyond traditional talent pools.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: Even as we reinvent, reorganise and reskill the Public Service to serve our people and nation better, the values and ethos of the Public Service must remain.

speaker: The Minister for Education (Mr Chan Chun Sing)
text: The Public Service will continue to reinforce the sense of purpose in our officers and leaders, and maintain the trust of Singaporeans.
